entities.summary: Blida is a city in Algeria. It is the capital of Blida Province, and it is located about 45 km south-west of Algiers, the national capital. The name Blida, i.e. bulaydah, is a diminutive of the Arabic word belda, city. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
